original:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं च भोगांश्च पाण्डवा भ्रातृभिः सह ।
प्रतस्थिरे महात्मानो महाप्रस्थानमुत्तमम् ॥
sanskrit:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं च भोगांश्च पाण्डवा भ्रातृभिः सह ।
प्रतस्थिरे महात्मानो महाप्रस्थानमुत्तमम् ॥
transliteration:
tyaktvā rājyaṃ ca bhogāṃśca pāṇḍavā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha |
pratasthire mahātmāno mahāprasthānam uttamam ||
translation: Renouncing kingdom and pleasures, the noble Pandava brothers together with Draupadi set forth upon the supreme Great Journey towards the Himalayas.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: राज्य और समस्त सुखों का परित्याग कर महात्मा पाण्डव भाई द्रौपदी सहित हिमालय की ओर महाप्रस्थान के पावन मार्ग पर निकल पड़े।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: राज्य आणि सर्व सुखांचा त्याग करून पांडव द्रौपदीसह हिमालयाकडे महाप्रस्थानाच्या श्रेष्ठ मार्गावर निघाले.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The Pandavas crown Parikshit as emperor in Hastinapura and Vajra in Mathura, turning their gaze toward immortality.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: Accompanied by a faithful dog—Dharma incarnate—Yudhishthira perseveres on the arduous mountain climb.
